name: OpenAI-Proof Q&A
intro: OpenAI-Proof Q&A 是 OpenAI 的闭源内部评测，包含20个真实研究与工程瓶颈。每个问题都曾使重大项目至少延误一天、并需要 OpenAI 团队超过一天才能解决；被测模型在含代码访问和运行工件的容器中诊断并解释根因。官方增补仅披露任务规模、案例条件、证据类型、pass@1 与图12结果，未公开任务内容、编写流程、评分器或试验协议。
build_method: 内部高影响研究工程瓶颈筛选, 历史代码日志实验数据和运行工件打包, 容器化闭源评测
modality: 文本, 代码, 日志, 指标, 运行工件
task_type: Agent诊断, 研究工程调试, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 真实内部瓶颈, 历史证据容器, 根因诊断与解释, 评分器和试验协议未公开
modality_en: Text, Code, Logs, Metrics, Run Artifacts
task_type_en: Agent Diagnosis, Research and Engineering Debugging, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Internal High-impact Research and Engineering Bottleneck Curation, Historical Code Log Experiment-data and Run-artifact Packaging, Closed Container Evaluation
eval_feature_en: Real Internal Bottlenecks, Historical-evidence Container, Root-cause Diagnosis and Explanation, Undisclosed Grader and Trial Protocol
intro_en: OpenAI-Proof Q&A is a closed internal OpenAI evaluation of 20 real research and engineering bottlenecks. Each problem delayed a major project by at least one day and required an OpenAI team more than one day to solve; evaluated models diagnose and explain the root cause in a container with code access and run artifacts. The official addendum discloses only the scale, case criteria, evidence types, pass@1, and Figure 12 results—not the task payload, authoring process, grader, or trial protocol.

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-22; source_kind=fixed_official_system_card_addendum_without_public_benchmark_repository. Fixed primary source: https://cdn.openai.com/pdf/ac7c37ae-7f4c-4442-b741-2eabdeaf77e0/oai_5_2_Codex.pdf, retrieved as a 22-page PDF with SHA-256 5fe918b740727770d0571684fd8c168190172649d2b2e8b7ca4cacad23b3e027. The authoritative locators are Table 8, Section 5.1.3.4, and Figure 12. Table 8 defines the capability as real-world ML debugging and diagnosis and asks whether models can identify and explain the root causes of real OpenAI research and engineering bottlenecks using historical code, logs, and experiment data. Section 5.1.3.4 states that the evaluation contains 20 internal bottlenecks encountered at OpenAI; every case represented at least a one-day delay to a major project, some influenced large training runs or launches, and each required more than one day for an OpenAI team to solve. It gives unexpected performance regressions, anomalous training metrics, and subtle implementation bugs as examples. The model receives a container with code access and run artifacts, must diagnose and explain the complex issue, and each solution is graded pass@1. The diagram preserves the union of the two official descriptions—Table 8 names historical code, logs, and experiment data, while the section explicitly names code access and run artifacts—without treating the wording difference as a separate construction step. Figure 12 reports pass@1 values of 2% for gpt-5-thinking, 0% for gpt-5.1-thinking, 8% for gpt-5.1-codex-max, 3% for gpt-5.2-thinking, and 8% for gpt-5.2-codex; all three Thinking variants are explicitly labeled no browsing, while the Codex variants are not. The caption says GPT-5.2-Codex performs on par with GPT-5.1-Codex-Max. The source does not disclose the sampling frame beyond the stated consequence and effort criteria, task-authoring procedure, reference solutions, container assembly, exact generation settings, grader implementation, acceptance rubric, repetitions, confidence-interval construction, or aggregation details. In particular, pass@1 does not justify inventing one attempt, one generated solution, or a specific number of trials per task, so the graph says only that each solution is graded pass@1. No public task payload, official benchmark Git repository, Hugging Face dataset, standalone homepage, or public leaderboard was found or claimed by the fixed official addendum. The benchmark therefore remains categorically in-house; source, construction-disclosure, grading-disclosure, wording-reconciliation, and openness boundaries are secondary dashed branches rather than primary stages. EN labels were checked for Chinese characters, ZH nodes carry Chinese semantics, EN/ZH positioned topology is identical, and formal drawio/arch/svg/png assets were intentionally not regenerated at source stage. Formal publication evidence [site-a12b-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1645×865 (English) and 1645×865 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1643×863 and 1643×863. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
